description: This file implements metrics collection and reporting for HTTPS service DNS queries within the Chromium project, including functions for translating DNS response codes, recording query times, and generating metric names.

classes.name: HttpssvcMetrics
classes.description: Class for collecting and recording metrics related to HTTPS DNS service queries.

methods.name: TranslateDnsRcodeForHttpssvcExperiment
methods.description: Converts a DNS response code into an internal enum used for HTTPS service metrics.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::HttpssvcMetrics
methods.description: Constructor initializing the metrics object with security status.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::~HttpssvcMetrics
methods.description: Destructor that triggers recording of collected metrics.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveForAddressQuery
methods.description: Records the resolve time and DNS response code for an address query.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveAddressQueryFailure
methods.description: Marks the current metrics as disqualified due to a query failure.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::SaveForHttps
methods.description: Records metrics for an HTTPS query, including response code, records, and resolve time.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::BuildMetricName
methods.description: Generates a metric name string based on query parameters.

methods.name: HttpssvcMetrics::RecordMetrics
methods.description: Processes and logs the collected metrics using UMA histograms.
